The '''Kassandre crime family''' was a criminal organization. The leaders of the family were killed by the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Limna Yith]] when she bombed the [[Alaspin casino]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
